topic: Facility tree API behavior and deployment
summary_markdown:
The session began with troubleshooting a 500 Internal Server Error encountered by [p1] after a merge, related to the facility tree API endpoint. Following fixes, it was confirmed that the `/api/facility/tree?conversion-source=true` and `/api/facility/tree?conversion-target=true` endpoints returning identical data is expected for facilities without defined source or target conversion rules.

It was noted that testing accounts (testjj on sandbox, [email@woco.dk] on stage/prod) should yield different results for these two parameters.

The team agreed to deploy the changes today.
decisions: The facility tree API endpoints are cleared for deployment today.
action_items: Deploy the updated facility tree functionality.
